evidence.notes: A page reference returns its configured URL.
A page reference exposes a mutable parameter map.
A page reference exposes a mutable header map.

source.content: PageReference page = new PageReference('/apex/Trail'); System.assertEquals('/apex/Trail', page.getUrl()); page.getParameters().put('id', '001000000000001AAA'); page.getHeaders().put('X-Test', 'yes'); System.assertEquals('001000000000001AAA', page.getParameters().get('id')); System.assertEquals('yes', page.getHeaders().get('X-Test'));
